newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Afghani man for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Afghani man for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded an Afghani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, the 11th execution in Saudi Arabia this month.
A Saudi Interior Ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the man was publicly beheaded in the capital Riyadh after a court found him guilty of smuggling heroin.
The execution raised to 34 the number of people put to death this year in Saudi Arabia, which enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
